name: Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM
author: Tecnología Geek

sections.description:
Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM puts the Dominican Winter League on your WordPress site: today’s games with live scores and the linescore by innings (runs, hits and errors), plus the season standings table (wins, losses, percentage, games back, last 10, streak, runs scored and allowed). Águilas Cibaeñas, Tigres del Licey, Leones del Escogido, Estrellas Orientales, Gigantes del Cibao and Toros del Este — the six LIDOM teams — updated automatically every 5 minutes, with an open page refreshing itself while the games are on.

Data comes from the MLB Stats API, the same free, keyless feed behind the big league scoreboards: the plugin caches every response (transients plus a scheduled WP-Cron warm-up every 5 minutes) and, if the service ever fails to answer, shows the last good copy instead of breaking your page. Built for Dominican news sites, sports blogs, community pages and diaspora sites that live the winter ball season from October to January.

Free version:

  • Today’s games with status (first pitch time, live inning, final) and team records.
  • Linescore by innings with R/H/E totals for every started game.
  • Full standings table of the current season.
  • Auto-refresh: the cache renews every 5 minutes (WP-Cron warm-up included) and open pages update themselves without reloading.
  • [lidom_en_vivo] shortcode to show it all inside any post or page.
  • Board language selector: Spanish (default), English, or automatic (your site language). Translations are delivered through translate.wordpress.org language packs; choosing English forces the original source strings.
  • Clean fixed design in the Dominican flag colors (blue, red and white) that adapts to mobile; last-good-copy fallback if the data service fails.
  • Fully translatable: English is the source language and every translation is delivered through translate.wordpress.org.
  • Lightweight: no jQuery, no tracking, no telemetry, no ads.

Premium version (available at tecnologiageek.com/plugins):

  • Full schedule and results by date: previous/next day navigation and a fecha shortcode attribute to pin any date.
  • Team filter: show only your team’s games (default filter plus a visitor selector).
  • Design panel: header colors and a compact linescore format.
  • Adjustable refresh (minimum 1 minute).
  • Ticker bar (modo barra): an optional scrolling bar with today’s games, inserted at the very top of every page in the page flow — it works with any theme and brings its own inline critical CSS — plus a [lidom_ticker] shortcode for manual placement, in the board colors and language. The bar is always visible: on days without games it stays up with a “No games today” note and the next scheduled game.
  • Widget with today’s games for sidebars.

En español: Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM lleva la Liga de Béisbol Profesional de la República Dominicana a tu WordPress: los juegos de hoy con marcadores en vivo y el detalle por entradas (carreras, hits y errores), más la tabla de posiciones de la temporada (ganados, perdidos, porcentaje, distancia, últimos 10, racha, carreras anotadas y permitidas). Los seis equipos — Águilas Cibaeñas, Tigres del Licey, Leones del Escogido, Estrellas Orientales, Gigantes del Cibao y Toros del Este — actualizados cada 5 minutos, con actualización automática de la página abierta mientras se juega. Los datos salen de la MLB Stats API, gratuita y sin clave: el plugin guarda cada respuesta en caché (transients y una tarea de WP-Cron cada 5 minutos) y, si el servicio falla, muestra la última copia buena en vez de romper la página. La versión gratuita incluye los juegos de hoy, el linescore por entradas, la tabla de posiciones completa, el shortcode [lidom_en_vivo] y un selector de idioma propio (español por defecto, inglés o automático según el sitio). La versión Premium — disponible en tecnologiageek.com/plugins — añade el calendario completo y los resultados por fecha con navegación por días, filtro por equipo, panel de diseño (colores y formato compacto), refresco ajustable desde 1 minuto, una barra ticker (modo barra) con los juegos de hoy para la parte superior de todo el sitio (con shortcode [lidom_ticker] de respaldo), visible siempre: los días sin juegos muestra el aviso «Hoy no hay juegos» con el próximo juego programado, y un widget.

External Service / Servicio externo

This plugin connects to one external service only: the MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com), the public data feed of MLB Advanced Media, which requires no API key and no account.

  • Endpoints used: GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule (games of a date, with linescores) and GET https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/standings (season standings), always for the Dominican Winter League (league 131, winter leagues sport 17).
  • What data is sent: only the league, date and season being displayed. Your own server makes the requests.
  • What is NOT sent: no data about your visitors (the requests are made by your server, not by their browsers), no site statistics, no telemetry, no tracking of any kind. Nothing is ever sent to the plugin author or to any other third party.
  • Requirements and costs: none. The MLB Stats API is free for this use and needs no key.
  • Data rights: baseball data © MLB Advanced Media, L.P. (https://www.mlb.com). Use of the data acknowledges agreement to the terms posted at http://gdx.mlb.com/components/copyright.txt. This plugin only displays scores, schedules and standings; it is not a betting product, and it is not affiliated with LIDOM or MLB.

En español: este plugin se conecta a un único servicio externo: la MLB Stats API (statsapi.mlb.com), la fuente pública de datos de MLB Advanced Media, sin clave de API ni cuenta. Solo se envían la liga, la fecha y la temporada que se están mostrando, y las peticiones las hace tu servidor, no el navegador de tus visitantes: no se envía ningún dato de visitantes, ni telemetría, ni rastreo, ni nada al autor del plugin ni a terceros. Los datos de béisbol son © MLB Advanced Media, L.P. Este plugin solo muestra marcadores, calendario y posiciones: no es un producto de apuestas y no está afiliado a la LIDOM ni a MLB.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tecnologia-geek-resultados-en-vivo-para-lidom folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin from the WordPress panel.
  2. Activate “Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM” in the Plugins menu.
  3. Put the [lidom_en_vivo] shortcode in any post or page. That is all: today’s games and the standings appear, refreshing every 5 minutes.
  4. Optional: Settings → Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM lets you choose the board language (Spanish by default), hide the standings table or the per-inning linescores, and shows the state of the data feed.
sections.faq:
Does it need an API key or an account?

No. The MLB Stats API is free and keyless: install, add the shortcode and it works.

Which league does it show?

The Dominican Winter League (LIDOM) only: its six teams, from the October opening to the January final series. The standings follow the season of the displayed date.

How fresh are the scores?

The data renews every 5 minutes in the free version (Premium: adjustable, minimum 1 minute). The winter league data is scored inside the MLB ecosystem; it can run a few minutes behind the broadcast.

What happens if the data service is down?

The block keeps showing the last good copy it stored, with its last update time, instead of an error.

Is this a betting plugin?

No. It only displays scores, schedules and standings. It sells no tickets, takes no bets and links to no bookmaker. It is not affiliated with LIDOM or MLB; the data is © MLB Advanced Media, L.P.

What does the Premium version add?

The full schedule and results by date (day navigation and a fecha attribute), a team filter, a design panel (colors, compact format), adjustable refresh (minimum 1 minute), a scrolling ticker bar with today’s games (modo barra, with a [lidom_ticker] shortcode) and a widget. Available at tecnologiageek.com/plugins.

Can I force the board language?

Yes. Settings → Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM has its own language selector: Spanish (the default), English, or automatic (follow the site language). English forces the original source strings; Spanish and automatic use the translation WordPress delivers for your site language through translate.wordpress.org.
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Renamed: the plugin is now “Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM” (new slug and text domain: tecnologia-geek-resultados-en-vivo-para-lidom), following the Plugin Directory trademark guidelines — the author’s brand goes first and the league is referenced descriptively at the end. The plugin is not affiliated with LIDOM or MLB.
  • Removed: the bundled .po/.mo translation files and the load_plugin_textdomain() call. Translations are now delivered through translate.wordpress.org language packs, as the directory requires.
  • Fixed: the return value of the lidom_before_games filter is now escaped with wp_kses_post() before the [lidom_en_vivo] shortcode prints it.

1.0.5

  • New: brand footer badge — a small centered line at the very end of every page, “LIDOM en Vivo · Created by Tecnología Geek”, linked to tecnologiageek.com/plugins. It follows the SITE language (not the board language selector), always shows in the free version, and the Premium version adds a free on/off switch in the settings page.

1.0.4

  • Changed (Premium): the ticker bar is now always visible. On days without games it no longer disappears: it shows a “No games today” note and, when a game is scheduled within the next 14 days, that next game with its date and time. Days with games are unchanged: the bar scrolls the scoreboard as before.

1.0.3

  • Fixed (Premium): the ticker bar changed its insertion mechanism again. It is now inserted into the page flow immediately after the opening body tag, with its critical CSS printed inline, so it no longer depends on wp_body_open, on position: fixed, or on the external stylesheet surviving CSS optimizers (on EnMinutos, WPZOOM Domino + Jetpack Boost, the 1.0.2 bar rendered at the end of the page despite arriving with its fixed styling). If a page already shows the bar through the [lidom_ticker] shortcode, the automatic bar is skipped on that page. Exactly one bar per page, as before.

1.0.2

  • Fixed (Premium): the ticker bar now prints even on themes that never fire wp_body_open (e.g. WPZOOM Domino): it is hooked to both wp_body_open (normal flow) and wp_footer (pinned to the top of the screen, fixed position) and prints exactly once through whichever fires first. The [lidom_ticker] shortcode keeps working for manual placement.

1.0.1

  • New: board language selector of its own (Spanish by default, English, or automatic/site language) in Lite and Premium, with a bundled Dominican Spanish (es_DO) translation — the board now speaks Spanish even on English-language sites.
  • New (Premium): ticker bar (modo barra) — an optional scrolling bar with today’s games at the top of every page (wp_body_open), plus a [lidom_ticker] shortcode for themes without that hook. Off by default; it follows the board language, colors and refresh.
  • Changed: default design colors now follow the Dominican flag — header blue #002D62, live accents red #CE1126, white text (the design panel can still change them).
  • All scoreboard strings now go through gettext (including the R/H/E linescore totals: C/H/E in Spanish).

1.0.0

  • Product release. Bilingual (English source, full Spanish translation included).
  • Free: today’s LIDOM games with live linescores, full standings table, 5-minute refresh (transient cache, WP-Cron warm-up and open-page auto-refresh), [lidom_en_vivo] shortcode, last-good-copy fallback.
  • Premium: schedule and results by date with navigation, team filter, design panel, adjustable refresh and widget, activated with a license key.

screenshots.caption: Today's games, live: the [lidom_en_vivo] scoreboard inside a page — three LIDOM games in progress with status and venue (Escogido at Gigantes in the 9th, Águilas at Estrellas in the 8th, Toros at Licey in the 7th), team records and the full linescore by innings with R/H/E totals.

The season standings table: all six LIDOM teams with wins, losses, PCT, games back, last 10, streak, runs scored and allowed — and the block footer with the last update time and the MLB Stats API data credit.

The settings page (Settings → Tecnología Geek Resultados en Vivo para LIDOM): show/hide toggles for the standings table and the per-inning linescore, the board language selector, the switch for the "Created by Tecnología Geek" footer line (on by default, fully optional), and the data feed status (league, season, games scheduled today and last successful update).
